texts: Three backfields broke in Week 3, and the waiver wire is stocked with running backs. The first dollar goes to Ollie Gordon II, the only Miami back standing after Achane's ACL. Claim him, 20 to 30 percent of FAAB. Let's get into it. #PhinsUp

1. Ollie Gordon II, MIA RB: 17 carries, a goal-line TD and 3 catches as the only active back. Claim, 20 to 30 percent.
2. Alvin Kamara, NO RB: Etienne is already ruled out for Week 4. Claim, 15 to 25 percent.
#PhinsUp #Saints

3. Kenyon Sadiq, NYJ TE: 7 catches, 105 yards and a TD on 8 targets with Mason Taylor out. Claim, 12 to 20 percent.
4. Braelon Allen, NYJ RB: played all 17 snaps after Breece Hall left. Claim, 8 to 12 percent. #JetUp

5. Tre' Harris, LAC WR: team-high 7 targets, routes on 27 of 43 dropbacks. Claim, 5 to 10 percent. #BoltUp
6. Keenan Allen, IND WR: 9 targets and a TD with Alec Pierce out. Claim, 3 to 6 percent. #ForTheShoe
7. Roman Wilson, PIT WR: exactly 6 targets in all three games, plus a 38-yard TD vs CIN. Claim, 3 to 5 percent, and bench him until his snaps climb back from 39 percent. #HereWeGo

Streamers. Geno Smith, NYJ: 31 of 37 for 321 yards and 3 TDs at DET. Stream him @CHI, 2 to 5 percent.
Tyler Higbee, LAR: 8 catches on 11 targets with Terrance Ferguson hurt. Stream him if Ferguson sits, 1 to 3 percent. #JetUp #RamsHouse

Stashes. Jaylen Wright, MIA: splits with Gordon once his stinger clears. Stash, 5 to 10 percent.
Kendre Miller, NO: next up behind Kamara. Stash, 1 to 3 percent.
Isaiah Davis, NYJ: 14-team leagues only, 0 to 1 percent. #PhinsUp #Saints #JetUp

Cut bait. Brian Thomas Jr., JAX: 1 target Sunday, 13 on the year to Parker Washington's 23. Drop him.
Xavier Worthy, KC: 2 targets on 19 routes. Drop him.
Kenny Gainwell, TB: 2.1 yards per carry. Drop him. #DUUUVAL #ChiefsKingdom #GoBucs

Monday night: CHI beat PHI 27-7 with Case Keenum at QB, and D'Andre Swift carried 20 times for 84 yards. Start Swift vs NYJ. Caleb Williams is out three to four weeks with a hamstring; leave Keenum and Tyson Bagent on waivers. #DaBears #FlyEaglesFly

Every add, stash and drop with the full FAAB read is on the site. Follow @FF_ChefHazy for the rest of the week's calls, and repost this for your league.
